profile_text.body:
Technology Innovation Institute (TII) is a government research laboratory based in Abu Dhabi, UAE, operating under the Abu Dhabi Government's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC), which oversees technology research in the emirate. The institute describes itself as a leading global research center dedicated to pushing the frontiers of knowledge, with teams of scientists, researchers, and engineers working across discovery science and transformative technologies. It is a non-profit organization.

On the AI side, TII develops Falcon, an open-source large language model released under the Apache 2.0 license and hosted in the UAE. Falcon is positioned as a sovereign AI offering with Middle East data residency, making it notable as a regionally anchored alternative to models developed in the United States or Europe. The model has its own dedicated site at falconllm.tii.ae.

The held facts record no litigation and no MCP server presence associated with TII. The institute has a verified profile on theworldofai.org as of August 2026.
